forgotPassword.heading: Reset password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter the email address you sign in with and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for that address, the link is on its way. Open it on this device — and check the spam folder if it doesn't arrive within a few minutes.

resetPassword.heading: New password
resetPassword.expired: The link has expired, has already been used, or was opened in a different browser than the one that requested it. Request a new one.

register.heading: Registration
register.closed: Registration is currently closed — the app is in a trial run. If you're a coach and want access, please contact the administrator.

errors.missingLoginFields: Fill in both email and password.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
errors.resetSessionMissing: The reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
